en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with a river in the foreground and dense trees along its banks. A tall round medieval tower with a domed roof stands near a stone gate on a hill, surrounded by historic buildings and sloping streets. Large institutional-looking buildings with mansard roofs dominate the skyline. On the left front, a multi‑storey house bears the sign "Alt‑Heidelberg". The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century cityscape.
